simple.meaning: רָשַׁשׁ (râshash) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to demolish.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Jeremiah, Malachi, beginning at Jeremiah 5:17. Its contexts include family line, flock, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רָשַׁשׁ (H7567).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: רָשַׁשׁ (râshash) / H7567 is traced through Jeremiah 5:17, Malachi 1:4 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: They will eat up your harvest and your bread, which your sons and your daughters should eat. They will eat up your flocks and your herds. They will eat up your vines and your fig trees. They will beat down your fortified cities in which you trust with the sword.
